rules.statement: Courts in Ceylon will enforce the English rule of equity that where property has been purchased by one person with money advanced for the purpose by another, a trust results in favour of the latter, provided there is clear and unequivocal evidence of the advance of purchase money.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is well settled that Courts in Ceylon will enforce the English rule of equity, that where property has been purchased by one person with money advanced for the purpose by another a trust results in favour of the latter. Ibrahim Saibo v. Oriental Bank Corporation (3 N. L. R. 148), Gould v. Inasitamby (9 N. L. R. 177 ) , Ohlmus v. Ohlmus (9 N. L. R. 188 ) ."
